name: Estuary Developer
free_limit: Free Developer tier: up to 10 GB data moved/month and 2 concurrent connector instances; no card required
watch_out: Developer is an ongoing free plan, not just a trial. Exceeding 10 GB/month or 2 connectors automatically starts a separate 30-day Cloud trial; after it ends, a payment method is needed to continue paid Cloud pipelines. Disable unneeded connectors to avoid subsequent charges.
